objective: Configurable portfolio concurrency across discovery, qualification, ready tests and execution, with idle capacity never beside executable backlog. (1) cash_modes gains max_live_discovery, max_validations_in_flight, max_need_research_in_flight (defaults 3, 2, 4) through a migration pair; MAX_VALIDATIONS_IN_FLIGHT becomes the default only and startValidations reads the mode's value. reconcileDiscoverableGaps raises need research only while fewer than max_need_research_in_flight need candidates are live (CAPTURED/QUEUED or mission RUNNING), ordering closest-to-ready first exactly like startValidations' closestFirst. (2) An independent block never stops other work: a NEEDS_PERSON dive, a parked need or a blocked opportunity holds no slot (assert this for the new need slots as validation already does). (3) The engineering watchdog's 'executable work beside idle capacity' reading includes Cash: when the fleet reports idle research capacity and the sprint has eligible-but-unstarted dives or needs held back only by these ceilings, record it through the existing engineering_interventions path rather than raising the ceiling automatically. (4) tests/cashConcurrency*.test.ts additions on both backends.
expectedOutcome: Several opportunities progress in parallel; one blocked piece never starves the rest; ceilings are a person's setting.
nonGoals: A second opportunity pipeline, queue, scheduler or polling loop beside the durable Russell tick and operate()
Changing the evidence gate, verification, audit roles or approval envelopes
A full-table read on every tick; every new read is narrow, indexed and bounded

acceptanceConditions.statement: concurrency tests pass on SQLite and Postgres

rollbackRequirement: Revert the commits; any migration only adds columns with defaults or a nullable column.
